description.value: The Champlain Heights Branch is part of the Vancouver Public Library system, serving the Champlain Heights and Killarney neighbourhoods in east Vancouver. As a public library, it offers free access to books, digital resources, and community programming in a welcoming, publicly accessible space. Touring cyclists passing through this residential corner of Vancouver will find a quiet rest stop with indoor seating.
